items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
items.claim: God speaks to Moses and Aaron with instructions

items.quote: When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle for you
items.claim: Pharaoh will request Moses and Aaron to show a miracle

items.quote: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh
items.claim: Aaron is commanded to take his rod and cast it before Pharaoh

items.quote: and it shall become a serpent
items.claim: The rod will transform into a serpent
